description: Multi-seed ablation of the calibrated coordinate-wise arcsinh transform for NUTS
notes: Every arm runs sample_blackjax_unified_nuts (BlackJAX window adaptation + NUTS) with the listed transform_kind.
total_grad_evals counts every leapfrog gradient including warm-up (and the initial evaluation per chain and phase).
bulk_ess/tail_ess are coordinate means; min_* are the worst coordinate. ESS and accuracy are measured on x.
max_rhat is the maximum rank-normalised split R-hat (ArviZ method='rank'); converged means max_rhat <= 1.01.
tail_prob_*: err = P_hat(x_i < q_p) - p at exact marginal quantiles q_p, z = err / ArviZ MCSE of the indicator; tail_prob_abs_* average |.| over coordinates and p.
q99_rel_error is the legacy |q99_hat - q99| / |q99| (coordinate mean); it is noise-dominated on Cauchy marginals.

tail_alignment_*: diagnostics/tail_alignment.py on the x draws (settings under config.tail_alignment). max_chi is the largest pairwise tail co-exceedance among coordinates whose Hill tail index is below max_tail_index (null with fewer than two such coordinates or too few draws); warning means max_chi > chi_threshold, a risk of heavy tails shared across coordinates, not a proven miss.
Ratios vs stock are paired by seed (same initial positions and JAX key) and summarised by median and IQR.
wall_time_sec includes JAX compilation and is machine-dependent; do not quote it as an efficiency measure.

stock.description: BlackJAX NUTS, window adaptation, target acceptance 0.8

arcsinh.description: NUTS on the calibrated coordinate-wise arcsinh pullback

affine.description: Same pipeline and Phase 1 calibration, z = (x - mu) / R, no arcsinh

scale_mixture.description: Stock NUTS on the non-centred Gaussian scale-mixture reparameterisation

tukey_h.description: Same pipeline and Phase 1, Tukey h-map x = mu + R z exp(h z^2 / 2); (R, h) by Tukey-h maximum likelihood, h = 0 unless a likelihood-ratio test (deflated by the effective sample size of the Phase 1 draws) rejects it

tukey_h0.description: tukey_h with the guard never rejecting (level 0): h = 0 on every coordinate

config.init: Uniform(-2.0, 2.0)^d per chain from numpy default_rng(seed), shared by all arms

target_descriptions.task1: Sparse regression, Cauchy(0, 1) priors, 3 active of 10 coefficients (SOTA Task 1)
target_descriptions.task3: Product form: t(nu) on 10 coordinates (nu = 1.2 to 2.5), N(0, 1) on 10 (SOTA Task 3)
target_descriptions.mvt_rot_nu1: Multivariate Cauchy (t, nu = 1), d = 10, rotated scale with condition number 25
target_descriptions.mvt_rot_nu2: Multivariate t, nu = 2, d = 10, rotated scale with condition number 25
target_descriptions.rot_prod_cauchy: Rotated product of Cauchys, x = Q diag(s) u with u iid Cauchy and s = geomspace(1, 5), d = 10
target_descriptions.gauss_rot: Rotated Gaussian, d = 20, covariance condition number 100
target_descriptions.gauss_aniso: Axis-aligned Gaussian, d = 20, standard deviations 0.1 to 10
